SERVICES
================================================================================

## Construction Cleaning Services

### Overview
Professional post-construction cleanup designed to transform construction sites into pristine, inspection-ready spaces. Our systematic 3-phase approach ensures thorough, efficient cleanup that meets inspection standards and project deadlines.

### 3-Phase Process

#### Phase 1: Rough Cleaning
- Major debris removal
- Construction material disposal
- Safety hazard elimination
- Initial dust control
- Large-scale cleanup

#### Phase 2: Detailed Cleaning
- Window cleaning (interior and exterior)
- Fixture cleaning and polishing
- Surface cleaning (all materials)
- Floor preparation
- Sticker and label removal
- Cabinet and millwork cleaning
- Light fixture cleaning

#### Phase 3: Final Inspection
- Touch-up cleaning
- Quality assurance inspection
- Floor protection installation
- Client walkthrough preparation
- Occupancy permit readiness

### Construction Projects Served
- Commercial buildings
- Residential developments
- Industrial facilities
- Healthcare construction
- Educational institutions
- Retail and shopping centers
- Multi-family housing
- Government buildings
- Manufacturing plants

### Specialized Construction Services
- Post-renovation cleanup
- Remodel finishing
- New construction final clean
- Tenant improvement cleanup
- Window construction cleanup
- Pressure washing (when applicable)
- Floor care and sealing

## Commercial Cleaning Services

### Overview
Comprehensive commercial cleaning and janitorial services designed to maintain professional, healthy, and productive business environments with flexible scheduling options.

### Standard Services
- Office cleaning and sanitization
- Restroom cleaning and restocking
- Break room and kitchen cleaning
- Floor care (vacuuming, mopping, buffing)
- Trash removal and recycling
- Window and glass cleaning
- Dusting and surface cleaning
- Reception area maintenance

### Specialized Commercial Services
- Medical facility cleaning
- Educational facility cleaning
- Industrial facility cleaning
- Retail store cleaning
- Restaurant and food service cleaning
- Gym and fitness center cleaning
- Property management cleaning

### Scheduling Options
- Daily cleaning
- Nightly cleaning
- Weekly cleaning
- Bi-weekly cleaning
- Monthly deep cleaning
- On-call services
- Emergency response

### Industries Served

- Medical and dental offices
- Healthcare facilities
- Educational institutions
- Government buildings
- Financial institutions
- Tech companies
- Manufacturing facilities
- Food processing plants
- Research laboratories
- Retail stores
- Restaurants

PRICING & QUOTING
================================================================================

## Pricing Factors
- Square footage of facility
- Type of cleaning (construction vs. commercial)
- Frequency of service
- Complexity of work
- Special requirements (medical, food-safe, etc.)
- Accessibility and timing constraints

## Quote Process
1. Contact via phone or website
2. Initial consultation (phone or site visit)
3. Detailed assessment
4. Written quote within 24 hours
5. No hidden fees or surprise charges

## Pricing Models
- Per square foot (construction)
- Flat rate projects
- Hourly rates for small projects
- Monthly contracts (commercial)
- Custom pricing for ongoing relationships

================================================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve all of Idaho (headquartered in Idaho Falls) and the Wasatch Front region of Utah (Logan, Ogden, Salt Lake City, Provo and surrounding areas).

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes, we are fully licensed in both Idaho and Utah, carry comprehensive general liability insurance, workers' compensation, and are bonded for all projects.

Q: How quickly can you respond?
A: Response times vary by location. Idaho Falls and Pocatello get immediate/same-day response. Boise, Twin Falls, and Utah locations typically receive 24-48 hour response. Emergency services are available 24/7 for all locations.

Q: Do you provide free quotes?
A: Yes, all estimates are free with no obligation. Most quotes are delivered within 24 hours.

Q: What is your construction cleanup process?
A: We use a proven 3-phase system: Phase 1 (rough cleaning and debris removal), Phase 2 (detailed surface and fixture cleaning), Phase 3 (final inspection and touch-up). This ensures every project is inspection-ready.

Q: Can you work around our business hours?
A: Absolutely. We offer flexible scheduling including nights, weekends, and holidays. We coordinate with your operations to minimize disruption.

Q: Do you have experience with specialized facilities?
A: Yes, we have expertise in healthcare, nuclear/DOE, food processing, educational, and government facilities, each with their specific compliance requirements.
